_about: Graphic templates the AI may use (spec Section 15). Shared by the server (AI prompt + validation) and the browser (drawing). The AI picks a template and fills props; it never writes drawing code. 'icon' enums are filled from icon-names.json.

templates.name: hookText
templates.description: Big punchy text for the first 5 seconds. Use ONCE, at the start, for the hook. Must be true to the video.

templates.name: titleCard
templates.description: Full-screen title card that hides the speaker. Use only at the start of a new chapter or topic, at most once per chapter.

templates.name: keywordCard
templates.description: A card defining a term the speaker is explaining. Use when a specific word or concept is introduced or defined. The definition must match what the speaker says.

templates.name: iconPop
templates.description: A single icon pops in next to the speaker, with an optional short label. Use to label a concrete thing being mentioned (a court, a vote, money, time).

templates.name: statCallout
templates.description: A number counts up with a label. Use ONLY when the speaker says a specific number, and the value must be exactly that number.

templates.name: titleBehind
templates.description: Huge bold 1-3 word title drawn BEHIND the speaker. Big-moment effect; use at most once per 3 minutes, on a key phrase.

cameraMoves.description: Instant zoom-in on a key line, exactly at a sentence start. At most one per ~15 s.
Instant zoom back to the full frame, at a sentence start.
Slow gentle zoom-in over a few seconds, for a serious or important moment.
Slide the speaker to one side to make room for a graphic.
